source.derived_from: read the recipe and wrote the cast and copy; did not copy upstream's placeholder text
source.note: card_sha256 is null because this reference brief was authored against the rendered shot rather than the card file; the ingest check will flag it and that is deliberate — see F051 step 'every reference brief cites the card it was derived from'.

render.energy_rationale: 六帧推完，能量全部压在 11 帧里；这一式没有落位后的停，所以它只能做插入式重音，不能承担叙事。

intent_zh: 把注意力一次性砸到某个点上；它是一记重音，不是一个镜头。
use_zh: 关键数字出现、错误态闪现、章节转场需要一个"停一下"的瞬间时
summary_zh: 全景一拍急推到目标特写（6f），落位二选一——过冲回弹（弹性）或撞停震屏（重量）

cast.note: The shortest brief in the reference set, on purpose: 11 frames cannot carry more than one actor and one gesture.

actors.art: the word START, ink on cream, already on screen when the push begins
actors.state_out: filling the frame, readable, with a 6% overshoot on the scale

beats.heading: push
beats.raw: Six-frame push from wide to target close-up.

beats.heading: land
beats.raw: Either an elastic overshoot or a dead stop with a shake. Pick one; they are not composable.

parameters.feel: 6f 是这式存在的意义；拉到 12f 它就退化成普通推镜，高能量消失

parameters.typical: 过冲回弹（弹性）｜撞停震屏（重量）
parameters.feel: 回弹读作轻快、震动读作沉重，两者传达的产品性格相反，必须按文案选
1.06 是可读上限；1.10 以上文字边缘开始抖
2px 在 1080p 下可见但不刺眼；4px 起会让压缩编码产生块效应

pitfalls.text: 两种落位方式不可叠加：回弹 + 震屏会读作设备故障。
11 帧没有安全落点，任何需要停留阅读的文案放不进来。
广角下推会拉伸边缘文字，1080p 需要 35mm 以上焦段。
不要在推镜期间加转场或溶解，会把 6f 拖成一次普通切换。

copy.note: The copy here is one word. That is a constraint of the card, not laziness: 11 frames cannot hold a sentence.

slots.hint: One line. If a demo uses 2 title words, keep 2 words.
slots.rationale: One line, 18 characters. A specific wrong number reads as a real account; 'Overspent' alone would read as a status label.
Omitted deliberately. The card has 11 frames and one actor; a subhead would compete with the number rather than supporting it.
Omitted. This shot is a punctuation mark between two longer beats, not a call to action.

notes: card_sha256 is null on purpose. It was authored from the render, not from the card file, and putting the card's hash here would claim a provenance the work does not have. The next revision of this brief should either re-author from the card and fill it, or delete the field.
11 frames is a hard ceiling on cast. This is the brief in the set that most clearly shows the card imposing structure on the copy rather than the other way round.
